start.title: Book your trip
start.subtitle: Tell us who is travelling. We hold the seats first, then you pay.

noOption.title: Pick a trip first
noOption.description: Search for a journey, choose an option, and come back here to book it.

optionError.title: We couldn’t load this trip
optionError.description: It may have expired or the connection dropped. Search again to get fresh prices.

travellers.title: Who is travelling?
travellers.hint: Names must match the ID each traveller will carry. At least one adult is needed; infants travel free on a lap.
travellers.phoneHint: Operators may call this number if a service changes.
travellers.savedError: Saved travellers are not available right now. You can still type the details.
travellers.partyNote: Fares were quoted for {adults, plural, one {# adult} other {# adults}}{children, plural, =0 {} one {, # child} other {, # children}}{infants, plural, =0 {} one {, # infant} other {, # infants}}, so the group is fixed here.
travellers.changeParty: Travelling with a different group? Search again.

errors.nameTooLong: Names can be up to 120 characters.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number with digits only, like +960 777 1234.
errors.adultRequired: At least one traveller must be an adult.
errors.tooManyInfants: Each infant needs an adult to travel with, one infant per adult.

summary.title: Your journey
summary.payOnBoardHint: Not sold here. You pay the operator directly.
summary.estimateNote: Any fees are added when we hold the seats, and you see the exact total before you pay.
summary.holdNote: Continuing holds your seats for {minutes} minutes. Nothing is charged until you pay.

problems.LEG_UNAVAILABLE: Leg {leg} just sold out, so we held nothing. Search again to see what is left.
problems.OPTION_EXPIRED: These prices have expired. Search again to get a fresh quote.
problems.OPTION_NOT_FOUND: We can’t find this trip any more. Search again.
problems.NOTHING_TO_BOOK: None of the legs on this trip can be booked here. Pay the operators directly.
problems.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details need fixing. Check the highlighted fields.
problems.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email address before booking. We sent a link when you signed up.
problems.FORBIDDEN: Verify your email address before booking. We sent a link when you signed up.
problems.AUTH_REQUIRED: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
problems.NETWORK: We couldn’t reach Dhathuru. Check your connection and try again. Retrying is safe: you won’t be booked twice.
problems.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong and nothing was booked. Try again.

checkout.title: Pay securely

loadError.title: We couldn’t load this booking
loadError.description: Your seats are still held while the timer runs. Try again.

notFound.title: Booking not found
notFound.description: It may belong to another account, or the link is wrong.

checkout.subtotalNote: All amounts are in Maldivian rufiyaa (MVR).

countdown.label: Seats held for
countdown.urgent: Hurry: your seats are released when this reaches zero.
countdown.normal: Your seats are held for you. Pay before the timer ends.

testMode.title: Test checkout: no real money moves
testMode.description: Dhathuru is not connected to a payment company yet. Use a test card below.

cards.legFailure: Charged, then a leg can’t be confirmed: full refund

card.title: Card details
card.name: Name on card
card.secureNote: Card details stay in your browser. We only ever send a one-time token.

errors.nameRequired: Enter the name on the card.
errors.numberInvalid: That card number doesn’t look right. Check the digits.
errors.numberNotTestCard: In this test checkout only the listed test cards work.
errors.expiryInvalid: Enter a future date as MM/YY.
errors.cvcInvalid: The security code is 3 or 4 digits.

processing.title: Processing your payment
processing.description: Please keep this page open. We’re confirming every leg of your trip. This can take a few seconds.

checking.title: Checking your payment
checking.description: We didn’t get a clear answer from the bank yet. We’re checking, and you will not be charged twice. Keep this page open.

verify.title: Verify this payment
verify.description: Your bank wants to check it’s you. Enter the verification code to finish paying.

errors.wrong: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again.

failure.title: Payment didn’t go through
failure.keepTrying: Your seats are still held. Try another card before the timer ends.

failed.title: We couldn’t complete this booking
failed.refund: If your card was charged, the full amount is being refunded. This usually shows within a few days, depending on your bank.
failed.seatsReleased: Any seats we held have been released.

expired.title: Your hold ran out
expired.description: The seats went back on sale and you were not charged. Search again to hold new ones.

checkout.expiredNotice: The timer reached zero. Checking with the operators…

problems.HOLD_EXPIRED: Your hold ran out before payment finished. You were not charged.
problems.PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: A payment for this booking is already being processed. Hold on while we check.
problems.NO_VERIFICATION_PENDING: There is no verification waiting for this booking.
problems.BOOKING_NOT_PAYABLE: This booking can’t be paid for any more.
problems.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email address before paying.
problems.FORBIDDEN: Verify your email address before paying.
problems.AUTH_REQUIRED: Your session ended. Sign in again, your seats are still held.
problems.NETWORK: We couldn’t reach Dhathuru. Retrying is safe: you won’t be charged twice.
problems.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. You haven’t been charged. Try again.

failure.CARD_DECLINED: The card was declined. Try another card.
failure.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The card has insufficient funds. Try another card.
failure.VERIFICATION_FAILED: The verification step failed. Try again or use another card.
failure.PAYMENT_TIMEOUT: The bank didn’t answer in time. You were not charged.
failure.GATEWAY_ERROR: The payment service had a problem. You were not charged.
failure.LEG_UNAVAILABLE: A seat on one of the legs was no longer available.
failure.LEG_CONFIRM_FAILED: One of the operators couldn’t confirm a leg, so we cancelled the whole trip and refunded you.
failure.HOLD_EXPIRED: The hold ran out before payment finished.

done.title: You’re booked
done.description: Every leg is confirmed and your tickets are ready.
done.emailNote: We’ve emailed your confirmation and itinerary.
done.payOnBoardBody: These legs aren’t sold through Dhathuru. Pay the operator directly: {legs}.

trips.title: My trips
trips.subtitle: Every journey you’ve booked, with live updates if anything changes.

error.title: We couldn’t load your trips
error.description: Your bookings are safe. Check your connection and try again.

empty.upcomingDescription: When you book a journey it appears here, with its tickets.
empty.pastDescription: Trips you’ve taken or that ended show up here.

card.disruptions: {count, plural, one {# update needs your attention} other {# updates need your attention}}

error.title: We couldn’t load this trip
error.description: Try again. Your booking is safe.

notFound.title: Trip not found
notFound.description: It may belong to another account, or the link is wrong.

detail.ticketsHint: Tickets appear once the booking is confirmed.

disruption.cancelled: Leg {leg} was cancelled by the operator
disruption.delayedBody: The operator reported a delay. Nothing on your booking has changed and you decide what to do.
disruption.cancelledBody: Your booking is unchanged until you choose. See the alternatives below, or contact the operator.
disruption.ackError: We couldn’t save that. Try again.
disruption.suggestionsNone: We couldn’t find an alternative that keeps your connections safe. Search for a new trip.
disruption.consent: We never rebook without your say-so.

cancel.title: Cancel this booking?
cancel.quoteError: We couldn’t work out the refund. Nothing has been cancelled. Try again.
cancel.consequences: Cancelling can’t be undone. The tickets for the cancelled legs stop working straight away.
cancel.refundTiming: Refunds go back to the card you paid with. Banks usually show it within a few days.
cancel.nothing: Nothing on this booking can be cancelled any more.

done.title: Booking cancelled
done.refund: {amount} is on its way back to your card.
done.noRefund: This cancellation had no refund due.

problems.CANCEL_FAILED: An operator didn’t confirm the cancellation yet. Nothing is lost: try again in a moment.
problems.CANCEL_IN_PROGRESS: A cancellation is already under way. Check back in a moment.
problems.BOOKING_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This booking can’t be cancelled any more.
problems.NOTHING_CANCELLABLE: Nothing on this booking can be cancelled any more.
problems.NETWORK: We couldn’t reach Dhathuru. Try again: retrying is safe.

wallet.title: Your tickets

error.title: We couldn’t load your tickets
error.description: Try again. Your booking is safe.

empty.title: No tickets yet
empty.description: Tickets are issued the moment your booking is confirmed.

wallet.qrAlt: QR code for the ticket from {from} to {to}, traveller {name}
wallet.scanHint: Brightness up. The operator scans this code at boarding.
